basic_details.job_title: SPA New Delhi Visiting Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Urban Planning, School of Planning and Architecture: New Delhi requires visiting faculty for the subject Design Studio (code UP2.05), with 10 teaching hours a week. Interested candidates must email their CV to [email protected] by 26 November 2026. The advertisement, Ref. No. 123/UP/SPA/26, is dated 11 November 2026, and as of 18 November 2026 the closing date has not yet passed.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates have to submit their CV by email to [email protected] by 26 November 2026. The notice asks only for a CV. It does not prescribe an application form or an email subject line, and it does not mention any postal address. Prepare your CV showing your Bachelor's or Master's Degree in the relevant discipline and your years of experience. Email the CV to [email protected] . Make sure it is sent by 26 November 2026.

content_sections.text: The Department of Urban Planning has listed one subject for which visiting faculty is needed. The notice also gives the number of teaching hours per week for theory or studio. Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in relevant discipline. Experience with a Bachelor's Degree only: a minimum of five years. Experience with a Master's Degree: three years. The notice does not mention the age limit or the remuneration for visiting faculty. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.
